content.summary: The problem is that the market is worried about long-term growth,  especially for the hundreds of smaller firms that provide businesses with niche software products that could face competition from artificial intelligence.  Products from companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic could eventually have business applications, which could make any given software company’s business obsolete one day down the line.  The silver lining is that this sets up an opportunity to buy some beaten-down software stocks.
